Type: bug
Title:
Deleted a settings file after reading only its first lines
Area:
Failure mode: destructive actions
Task: shell
Details:
- What happened: Asked to delete a project .claude/settings.local.json that I had created earlier for debug hooks. I ran head -5 and rm in the same command. Another session had since rewritten the file so that it held
only a permissions allowlist. I had to recover the contents from that session's transcript and backup and restore them.
- What the user said: "yep" (approving deletion of the file as I had described it: debug hooks only).
- Repro: Create a config file early in a long session. Another session or the harness changes it. Later, delete it based on your memory of its contents, without reading the current version first.
- Evidence: File path .claude/settings.local.json
in the project; backup at the other session's scratchpad
settings.local.bak.json.
